subject.title: Long-context compression benchmark
subject.scope: Benchmark compressed skim plus exact recovery before any product integration

failure_modes.failure: Aggregate quality hides exact-recovery regressions on rare tasks.
failure_modes.hypothetical_narrative: A high mean score makes the candidate look safe while one release-critical locator is unrecoverable.
failure_modes.selection_rationale: Directly threatens the integration gate and can be detected with per-task failure counts.
failure_modes.mitigation: Retain per-task exact-recovery failures and block integration on any regression against the best baseline.

failure_modes.failure: The compression strategy is tuned to synthetic fixtures rather than real AIWG work.
failure_modes.hypothetical_narrative: A benchmark passes because its tasks resemble the implementation's hand-written examples.
failure_modes.selection_rationale: Affects external validity and is mitigated by required real AIWG tasks.
failure_modes.mitigation: Require labeled real AIWG tasks and preserve fixture provenance.

failure_modes.failure: A weak or inconvenient baseline is omitted from the report.
failure_modes.hypothetical_narrative: The candidate appears best only after the strongest provider-context result disappears.
failure_modes.selection_rationale: Selective reporting invalidates the conclusion even when the candidate numbers are correct.
failure_modes.mitigation: Require all named baselines and preserve weak and failed results.

failure_modes.failure: Exact recovery improves quality but creates unacceptable latency or memory use.
failure_modes.hypothetical_narrative: An interactive workflow stalls as recovery repeatedly scans a large source corpus.
failure_modes.selection_rationale: Operational regressions can make a quality win unusable and are measurable in the benchmark.
failure_modes.mitigation: Report latency, memory, and operational constraints beside quality.

failure_modes.failure: Benchmark output is treated as automatic authorization for product integration.
failure_modes.hypothetical_narrative: A blocked experiment is shipped because its report is mistaken for a release approval.
failure_modes.selection_rationale: Separates experimental evidence from the product decision and limits blast radius.
failure_modes.mitigation: Emit a distinct integration state and require separate product review.

failure_modes.failure: Provider behavior changes after the benchmark snapshot.
failure_modes.hypothetical_narrative: A provider update alters retrieval behavior and makes the preserved ranking stale.
failure_modes.selection_rationale: Important for future reruns but less immediate than benchmark validity failures.
failure_modes.mitigation: Record provider versions and rerun before adoption.

citations.claim: Compression should be benchmarked against summary, retrieval, and provider-context baselines.
A universal five-risk deep-dive threshold is decision-science optimal.
citations.risk: No induced source currently supports a universal optimum; the 3-7 bound is a workflow constraint, not an empirical law.
